title: Airport Map (OANS toolbar window)
creator: Free Airport Mapping DB, from FlyByWire Simulations' A380X OANS

neutral.LastUpdate: An airport moving map (FlyByWire's A380X OANS) in a toolbar window, for any aircraft, with taxi routes: type a clearance such as A B K 31L and the way is drawn in magenta. Needs AMDB Bridge or the A320 OANS program running. GPL-3.0; see README.txt.
